construction: Reuse all existing SegFormer+GrabCut masks, rerun only GrabCut with padded component extent at 0.25. Keep the same 160 raw inputs and 1%-50% numerical gates. No scoring mask dependency.
review: Assistant coarse semantic input review before scores; no manual contour IoU claims, minor boundary errors tolerated. Pace one case at a time; do not inspect many images rapidly.
method_selection: Scoring stays frozen v5 from the original 34 development bases, regardless of baseline follow-up scores.
claim_limit: The official natural videos and their preference labels were previously scored. Seed-0 construction was attempted across all 72 prompts. These new seeds/corruptions in disjoint explicit intervention-development prompt groups are a grouped follow-up, not wholly unseen independent natural data.
rationale: Before looking at follow-up scores, the lexicographically first cow shows major lower-body/head omissions. Original hard background outside five pixels prevents recovery. One visual-only diagnostic recovers these parts with widened extent. Apply the same fixed rule to every candidate, preserving all original results and rejects.
